summary.headline: Afternoon sun, 2 to 4 hours a day
summary.subline: From about 14:30 until about 17:45. Most in May, least in December.

advice:
Verdict: This is an afternoon-only sunset spot with 2 to 4 hours of late sun, best in May with 4.3 hours from 13:51 to 18:07 and weakest in Dec with 1.7 hours from 15:10 to 16:49.
Blocked by: the large tree to the west, costing about 1.6 hours a day in April and August.
Good for: sunset tea, shade-tolerant herbs, evening reading
Not for: morning sunbathing, full-sun tomatoes, solar panels
Tip: Place chairs and a pet bed west for warm evenings but keep plants where gaps let light through.
